decision_rule.admit_selector_training_design_if: At least one deterministic train-only selector clears all gates: validation accuracy over train-majority floor >= 0.15, each required rare validation family frame accuracy >= 0.5, row-level selectors also classify every required rare validation row with positive margin, and predicted-family validation reconstruction MSE <= 0.1.
decision_rule.negative_if: Target and representation remain alive by M3237, but no selector clears the selector battery gates.
decision_rule.next_process: If negative, close the local family-selector repricing branch, keep C2/C3 blocked, and do not run more local selector/interface training before a PI/new-interface decision. If positive, admit only a separate selector-training design/quick registration; no C2 admission.
